title: Principal Software Engineer - DV Cleared
description:
PRINCIPAL SOFTWARE ENGINEER - UKSV DV CLEARED

Location: London (Hybrid)
Clearance: UKSV DV
Sector: Central Government / National Security
To Apply, email:

I'm currently working with a leading organisation delivering highly secure technology solutions across Central Government, looking to bring on an experienced Principal Software Engineer.

THE ROLE

You'll play a key role in designing and developing secure, scalable software solutions across high-profile Central Government projects, taking technical ownership and helping shape engineering practices across complex environments.

TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE:
- Strong commercial experience with Python software engineering.
- Experience building and deploying production-grade applications and services.
- Docker, Kubernetes and containerisation technologies.
- AWS cloud infrastructure and architecture.
- CI/CD pipelines and modern DevOps practices.
- Experience building environments to support the deployment and operationalisation of Machine Learning models.
- Strong understanding of software architecture, engineering best practices and technical leadership.

THE OPPORTUNITY
- Salary up to £130,000.
- Hybrid working in London.
- Work on highly secure Central Government projects.
- Opportunity to influence technical direction and engineering standards.
